about.title: About
about.heading: About
about.introduction: The congregation at the Presbyterian Church of Roseville, Lindfield, and Killara is part of the PCNSW, embracing the Bible as God’s inspired, infallible, and inerrant word.
about.second_paragraph: The reading and preaching of God’s word occupies a prominent place in the worship services, including singing from the song book of Christ our Lord – the Psalms.
about.third_paragraph: All who desire to draw near to the living God in worship – or just to visit and see – are warmly invited to join the congregation at Roseville Presbyterian.

bsf.title: Bible Study Fellowship
bsf.heading: Bible Study Fellowship
bsf.introduction: BSF is a weekly Bible study for women. The Roseville group meets on Tuesdays at 10:00am at Roseville Presbyterian Church, 28 Lord Street.
bsf.second_paragraph: Members study Scripture during the week, then gather to discuss it in a small group, hear teaching and use the lesson notes to explore the passage further.
bsf.third_paragraph: Check the BSF class listing for current dates and joining details.
